## Goal
Fix Stripe webhook signature verification failures in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`, where customers receive HTTP 400 responses.

## Constraints and rules
- Never modify/create Stripe webhooks without an ADR link in `#billing-integrations` and tagging `@priya`.
- Staging must use `cache-eu-3`; `cache-eu-1` is draining and must not receive writes.
- Run Elasticsearch alias-swap steps sequentially, checking responses.
- Reconciliation metric: `invoice_reconcile_seconds`; labels only `service`, `environment`, `status`, `tenant_tier`.
- Report exact test output.

## Key decisions and facts
- Full lint/test baseline: Ruff clean; `149 passed, 2 skipped in 8.42 seconds`.
- Invoice pagination warning was fixed despite pagination work being deprioritized.
- ES count verified both indices at 18,432 documents; `orders_v1` write block acknowledged.
- SQLAlchemy modernization, UTC timestamps, explicit imports, and injected billing session are complete.
- Redis staging endpoint is now `cache-eu-3`.

## Ruled out
- Invoice covering-index approach.
- Per-currency invoice-summary queries.

## Progress
Webhook signature issue has not yet been investigated or changed.

## Next steps
Inspect Stripe webhook handler/signature configuration and tests; obtain required ADR link and tag before edits; add regression coverage and run exact relevant tests plus Ruff.
